svg.title: Plains Training Yard design proposals
svg.desc: Floor reservations and schematic front elevations for a 13 by 17 practice yard and 17 by 19 drill courtyard. Blue circulation runs behind the south-facing drill bays and beside the target fields. The large court adds a west pavilion and rear loop. These are untested design proposals.
svg.text: Rustic village practice grounds with sheltered work space and clear circulation
DESIGN PROPOSALS — NOT MINECRAFT TEST RESULTS
13 x 17 x 8 blocks | road north / targets south
Two sheltered drill positions aim away from the road.
The east passage ends in a service corner. No rear loop.
Roof outline includes the entrance row and supported margins.
Open firing face, supported timber roof, stone base.
17 x 19 x 9 blocks | road north / targets south
A rest pavilion and clear 4 x 4 assembly court on the west.
The two-wide loop passes behind the solid backstop.
Doors connect the pavilion to both ends of that loop.
Open firing face, supported timber roof, stone base.
A / B: initial cells D1 / D2: proposed duties Dashed outline: roof coverage
Targets remain decorative. Geometry, native walking, actual guard positions, and gunfire need packaged-game validation.
